collection.title: Audi Q2 2016 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Audi Q2 2016 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Q2 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
